items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: Bucky’s there. He and Bucky go back forever.

ctx.x: Yeah, a lot of good musicians. Bucky [Pizzarelli].
Bucky’s there. He and Bucky go back forever. Yeah.
Wow. Do you ever — sometimes I’m fascinated about living in another era. And I wonder if you ever have done that? For musical reasons?
